answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to forge a verifiable work history before it earns full trading rights: completed tasks are countersigned by two independent peers and recorded in a public ledger, so a fresh identity starts with zero reputation. Think of a wharf where only boats that have actually docked at the jetty and unloaded real cargo gain priority berths — creating a hundred fake agents costs a hundred real histories, which makes mass forgery unprofitable.
